domain: Editorial Authority, Google EEAT & Copywriting Psychology

heuristics.name: Information Gain Axiom
heuristics.rule: Never repeat generic vendor marketing. Ground every article in proprietary calculations (e.g. 100k scale unit economics, task multiplier penalties).
heuristics.impact: Boosts Google Helpful Content ranking and decreases bounce rate.

heuristics.name: The Cold Opening Mandate
heuristics.rule: The first 3 sentences must state an arresting metric, contrarian engineering thesis, or expensive architectural mistake. ZERO generic intro fluff.

heuristics.name: Empirical Table Density
heuristics.rule: Every flagship guide must feature at least one multi-column ASCII/Markdown benchmark table comparing legacy TCO vs modern unit costs.
heuristics.impact: Correlates directly with average reading dwell time exceeding 2m 45s on Cloudflare RUM.

heuristics.name: Trojan Value Positioning
